taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Vitamins and Nutrition content covering fat-soluble vitamins, vitamin A vision and immunity roles, and vitamin D calcium homeostasis.

words.clue: Aggregates formed from bile salts and lipids that enable absorption of fat-soluble vitamins in the small intestine
The alcohol form of vitamin A that serves as the transport molecule in blood
Visual pigment in rod cells that contains retinal as its chromophore for dim light vision
Night blindness; the earliest clinical sign of vitamin A deficiency affecting the visual cycle
Dryness of the eyes and conjunctiva resulting from vitamin A deficiency and epithelial damage
Corneal melting and ulceration that represents the irreversible stage of severe vitamin A deficiency
The chemical name for vitamin D3 synthesized in the skin under ultraviolet B light
The active hormonal form of vitamin D produced by 1-alpha-hydroxylase in the kidney for calcium regulation
Metabolic bone disease in children characterized by inadequate mineralization and skeletal deformities like bowing of legs
Adult bone disease manifesting as bone pain and muscle weakness from vitamin D deficiency
Toxic condition resulting from chronic excessive supplementation of fat-soluble vitamins like A and D
